Conviene ser preciso con lo que el teore: It is worth being precise about what the theorem says and what it does not. It does not say that the regulator “understands” anything, or that it has a conscious representation, or that there is a little picture of the world inside it. It says something more modest and more solid: that its structure has to distinguish the same things the regulated system distinguishes. A thermostat contains a model of the room in that sense and only in that sense: it distinguishes “it is cold” from “it is hot”, which is exactly the distinction it needs to do its job.

En 1970, Roger Conant y Ross Ashby publi: In 1970, Roger Conant and Ross Ashby published a paper with a title that is already the whole statement: Every good regulator of a system must be a model of that system — every good regulator of a system has to be a model of what it regulates.
Ese fenómeno tiene un nombre en gestión: That phenomenon has a name in management and is one of the most robust regularities known: Goodhart's law, usually stated as “when a measure becomes a target, it ceases to be a good measure”. If a hospital is assessed by the waiting time in its emergency department, the waiting time improves and stops informing about the quality of care; if a developer is measured by lines of code, they write more lines. The indicator couples with what it indicates, and from then on it measures above all the act of measuring itself.

La cibernética se disolvió repartiéndose: Cybernetics dissolved by sharing itself out among disciplines, and the best thing it left was the habit of joining tools from different subjects for one and the same problem.
La cibernética vivió una historia curios: Cybernetics had a curious history: it was enormously influential and at the same time it dissolved. Its ideas were shared out among disciplines that do not cite it today: control theory went to engineering, information theory to telecommunications, automata and neural networks to computing, system dynamics to economics and ecology, and the second-order part to the social sciences and family therapy. Wiener died in 1964, Ashby in 1972, and by the 1980s the word sounded old-fashioned; today it survives mostly as a prefix, in “cyberspace” or “cybersecurity”, which is a somewhat humiliating fate for a discipline that wanted to explain the thermostat and the brain at once.

Y sin embargo, si has llegado hasta aquí: And yet, if you have come this far from the first topic of the course, you will have noticed that the pieces fitted together by themselves. The correction loop, entropy, eigenvalues, the derivative as anticipation and the integral as memory, the equilibrium of a dynamical system, the probability of getting it right by shuffling at random: all of that was scattered throughout the course and here it has been used together to answer a single question. That capacity to join up things that seemed to belong to different subjects is, surely, the best thing cybernetics left behind, and it is also what this course has tried to teach from day one: that mathematics is a language in which almost anything can be said, including how something stays standing.

Último tema del bloque, y el que menos c: The last topic of the block, and the one that computes least. It takes up the law of [[cib-variedad|variety]] and carries it a step further: a regulator not only needs enough moves, it needs them paired up with the situations.
